title: PerezBlanco2026: Wrist-motion (4-direction pointing) motor-execution dataset
description: This dataset contains simultaneous EEG and EMG recordings from 45 healthy participants performing a four-direction wrist-pointing task with a 3-DoF wrist exoskeleton. Movements covered flexion, extension, radial deviation and ulnar deviation, with continuous visual feedback and cue-based trials over multiple runs. It supports research on motor control, biomarkers and neurorehabilitation.
methods_description: EEG (8 channels, 10-10 montage, g.GAMMAcap) and EMG (8 channels) were recorded at 512 Hz with a g.tec g.USBamp, referenced to the right ear with AFz as ground. Participants performed 4-direction wrist pointing with the Biomech Wrist exoskeleton, with flexion-extension driving horizontal cursor motion and radial-ulnar deviation driving vertical motion. Each session had at least 8 runs of 40 trials (10 per movement). Data were converted from BCI2000 .dat to BIDS EDF.
